rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase, 3/1/2026–2/28/2027
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the maximum annual rent increase from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent.
rules.requirement_es: Para las unidades con control de alquileres en San Francisco, el aumento anual máximo permitido del 1 de marzo de 2026 al 28 de febrero de 2027 es del 1.6% de la renta base del inquilino.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled units under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance.
rules.caveat: Rate is adjusted yearly (prior year 1.4%); the notice does not give the specific code section, so the citation is approximate.
